name: AI Illustrated News
description: Once a day, the top story of each of your feeds, summarised by an AI and drawn as a satirical ink cartoon (kie.ai, Gemini, Pollinations or HuggingFace). Shows one story at a time, poster style, moving to the next on each refresh.

cell_options.name: show_summary
cell_options.label: Summary
cell_options.help: The story's summary under the headline, where the cell has room for it.

cell_options.name: show_source
cell_options.label: Source and date
cell_options.help: The feed's label, the story's date and which story of how many.

settings.name: groq_api_key
settings.label: Groq API key
settings.help: Writes the summaries. Without it a story shows the opening words of the article. Get one at console.groq.com/keys.

settings.name: kie_api_key
settings.label: kie.ai API key
settings.help: Draws the pictures with kie.ai. Get one at kie.ai/api-key.

settings.name: gemini_api_key
settings.label: Gemini API key
settings.help: Draws the pictures with Gemini. Get one at aistudio.google.com/apikey.

settings.name: pollinations_api_key
settings.label: Pollinations API key
settings.help: Draws the pictures with Pollinations. Get one at enter.pollinations.ai.

settings.name: huggingface_api_key
settings.label: HuggingFace token
settings.help: Draws the pictures with HuggingFace. Get one at huggingface.co/settings/tokens.

sample.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
sample.summary: Ukraine's defence minister said the country now has a stable Starlink connection after days of limited satellite internet that hampered military operations.
